description: Submit your answer to a request you claimed (or a revision after a send-back). Answer the request's 'Done when' checks point by point. Add sources you actually opened, the assumptions you made and the gaps you couldn't fill: they're signed into the receipt with the answer, and honest gaps earn better ratings than confident guesses.

artifacts.description: Optional files: link large ones by URL.

assumptions.description: What the answer took for granted.

gaps.description: What you couldn't find or verify.

sources.description: Where the answer comes from. Signed into the delivery receipt with the answer.

token.description: Optional API key (zck_...), session token or guest requester_token for this call only. Overrides the connection's Authorization header. Use it to follow up on a request you posted as a guest.

name: deliver_answer
title: Deliver an answer
